source: Web security course quiz (PortSwigger based), provided by the course instructor. On 2026-11-25, 9 links that PortSwigger had moved (they returned 404) were updated to the same pages' current addresses.
rules: Use Burp Suite during your work.
Complete the labs in the PortSwigger browser environment.
Do not open the Solution section on PortSwigger. Opening it results in a 0.
Refreshing the page does not reset or pause the timer.
When the time is over, the exam locks until the instructor unlocks it.
